# Shutter

**Motion › Split** · v1.0.0 · 30 frames at 30 fps (12–60)

The old scene splits into two halves that slide apart like doors, with the new scene behind them.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/shutter@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Grand reveals
- Product launches
- Openers

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import shutter from './transitions/05-motion/split/shutter';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(shutter, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 30 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | enum | `"vertical"` | `vertical` · `horizontal` | vertical: halves part left and right. horizontal: up and down. |
| `scaleIn` | number | `0.08` | 0–0.3 | How much the new scene settles from a zoom as it is revealed. |
